{"
What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
WSP Digital are a team of innovators within WSP Australia that uses future ready Digital Technologies to enhance our customers' engineering, infrastructure, building, and environmental projects. 
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our innovative Brisbane offices and be an integral part of our National Data Science team. 
This is a fantastic opportunity for a Data expert to work on a host of major projects not only in Queensland, but both nationally and globally whilst helping to positively impact the lives of the communities for generations to come! Plus, you will also have the chance to work with some of the brightest subject matter experts in the world! 
WSP Australia is one of the world's leading engineering professional services consulting firms, bringing together approximately 6,000 talented people across more than 50 offices in Australia and New Zealand. We are technical experts who design and provide strategic advice on sustainable solutions and engineering projects to help societies grow for lifetimes. 
At WSP you’ll find the scale and reach you need to do the kind of work the world needs – and the culture and people that make it the best work of your life! 
Digital 
Our Digital team applies the latest technological innovations to our client’s complex problems across sectors and projects. 
Our integrated service combines not only Data Analytics, but a full suite of Digital solutions including software development, Geospatial, Visualisation, Digital Engineering, and Cloud Technologies to deliver information and efficiency that supports decision-making, time and cost savings, and improved community outcomes. 
The team are spread all over the east coast of Australia, with a wide variety of skills from application development, spatial analysis, map production, modelling, reporting and data manipulation and acquisition. 
As our Senior Data Analyst, you will be responsible for identifying, prioritising, and solving complex engineering business problems by developing advanced statistical analysis and business intelligence (BI) solutions. This includes creating and maintaining data pipelines, performing data cleansing, transforming data into insightful dashboards and reports, and providing actionable insights to support decision-making processes. 
You will also be working with a range of government and commercial clients to enhance the operation and maintenance of many critical infrastructure systems that keep our world moving - Many of our clients operate large-scale, network-based systems such as road, rail, and water supply networks, with tangible outcomes that affect us all. 
Some of the exciting projects the team have worked on, have included: 
Department of Transport and Main Roads (TMR) - TMR have tested and deployed Cooperative Intelligent Transport Systems (C-ITS) in real-world, large-scale deployments in Queensland. WSP has been working with TMR to provide technical expert support, including centralised application development and the Integration and DevOps of AWS Cloud Infrastructure. 
Sydney Water - In response to high-volume breakdown maintenance activities, the DevOps team designed and implemented a new approach to planning and scheduling mechanical and electrical asset maintenance. 
Telstra Digital Workflow - We developed an online forms service that allows NSW Family and Community Services (FACS) applicants to fill out, submit, and manage applications and responsible parties to be notified and contribute to the application workflow. 
Energy Rating – We built a website that facilitates evaluating and issuing of energy ratings for electrical appliances for sale in Australia and New Zealand. 
If you would like to see more of the cool things that our Digital team at WSP get up to, please do check out their dedicated website, here - https://www.wsp.com/en-au/hubs/digital-solutions  
A typical day for a Senior Data Analyst at WSP would look like (but not be limited to): 
· Working with clients to understand their needs and devise novel solutions. 
· Collaborating with other engineering and digital disciplines, such as Digital engineering and Location Intelligence, to deliver complex multi-disciplinary projects across various engineering fields. 
· Anticipate, characterise, and manage complex real-world data's limitations and implications, conceiving effective workarounds or alternative mitigations to deliver successful outcomes. 
· Taking corrective action and making tough decisions to recover or successfully implement projects. 
· Working with massive and complex data sets from multiple sources, utilising big data tools and techniques to analyse, provide insight and validate hypotheses. 
· Translating analytical insights into concrete, actionable recommendations for business, process, or product improvements. 
· Making recommendations for the collection of new data or the refinement of existing data sources and storage. 
· Collaborating with subject matter experts to deliver and solve real-world engineering problems. 
· Collaborating across the business to influence change and bring ideas to life. 
· Creating solutions that will benefit the wider community. 
· Contributing to creating a more sustainable future. 
What we'll love about you: 
You will have an extensive experience as a Senior Data Analyst - experience may be a mix of corporate or government and experience in Asset Management and/or Water industry would be seen as very useful.  
Enthusiasm for consulting and winning work by building client relationships is also key to be successful in this role. 
You can ideate and set vision and scope for complex data-driven projects, including a deep understanding of client value-proposition and stakeholder needs.  
Required extensive experience in:

Data transformation and understanding new datasets 
BI platforms such as PowerBI 
FME, GIS and Ellipse data would also be favourable, but not required.  

Skills that would be advantageous, but not required: 

Understanding of core data analyst, statistical concepts and methods, and knowledge of data schemas such as asset classes 
Knowledge and experience in AWS and/or Azure. 
Experience with Data Warehousing. 
Ability to manipulate and analyse complex, high-volume, high-dimensionality data and metadata from varying sources. 
Passion for empirical research and for answering hard questions with data. 
Proven history of successful client adoption and/or operationalisation of analytical and statistical reports 
Expert knowledge of analytical tools and cloud data services 
Demonstrated knowledge of relational/structured data manipulation 
Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner. 
Analytical approach that allows for results at varying levels of precision. 
Strong ability to mentor junior staff. 
Solid understanding with software engineering practice & principles. 
Preference for Python based software development experience 

 In addition, you will bring the following skills and attributes:  

Natural connector 
Problem solver with a powerful team spirit 
Open 
Curious 
Passionate 
Adaptable 
Someone ready to do the kind of work the world needs 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.
Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.
"}

job_details: {"The RoleThe Role will be in the Health Surveillance Cell within the Directorate of Force Health Protection (DFHP). job_details:
{"Our participants, Our people, Our purpose
Currently, there are around 4.3 million Australians with a disability. The National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA) implements the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), which is one of the biggest social reforms in the country since Medicare. As an Agency, we support more than 600,000 participants with a significant and permanent disability, and the families and carers of those living with disability. For many Australians, this will be the first time they receive the disability support they need. The NDIA is designed to enhance the quality of life and increase economic and social participation for people with disability and will mean a peace of mind for every Australian.
A new role awaits
The Fraud Fusion Taskforce and Integrity Capability Division (the Division) has several APS6 Data Analyst opportunities across the Intelligence and Analytics Branch.  The Division drives the Agency’s integrity response and capability uplift as well as the coordination of the whole-of-government multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT).Our Division is responsible for: 

Investigating and responding to internal and external fraud against the NDIS which includes undertaking criminal investigations of serious and organised fraud against the NDIS in partnership with Fraud Fusion Taskforce member agencies.
Managing the tip-off process and collecting?intelligence about integrity concerns to ensure this is acted upon. We develop risk profiles through detection analytics which inform our responses.
Scalable responses, targeted at specific integrity vulnerabilities and cohorts, to address known and emerging integrity and fraud matters.
Fraud investigations, which will progress to prosecutions for serious cases.
Overall governance and management of the multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). This includes development of agreed strategic prevention concepts and priorities across FFT agencies and reporting of savings and benefits.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you
As an APS 6 Data Analyst, you will be accountable under limited direction to undertake complex work that is guided by legislation, policies, procedures, standards, methodologies and precedents.  You will assist in the extraction and production of a range of data, statistics, and reports using Statistical Analysis System (SAS), SQL queries and SAS Visual Analytics (VA).  You will provide expertise and technical knowledge across a range of programs or activities including anticipating problems and contributing to issues management and support the development of detection profiles including requirements, design, testing training and rollout  You will manage relationships with stakeholders to achieve work area goals and communicate and negotiate with clients or stakeholders under limited direction, to maximise acceptance and cooperation and support your team and other initiatives as directed, including the managing, or responding to enquiries including email and Service Desk tickets.  Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and organizational policies, you will maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive information. Working closely with management, operational teams, and external partner agencies, you will ensure that intelligence outputs support the strategic and operational needs of the NDIA. Additionally, you will support and contribute to continuous improvement activities, including the development of systems, processes, and practical tools. A strong understanding of machine learning and statistical concepts is highly desirable for this role. Your role will involve identifying opportunities for improving data collection and analysis processes, recommending and implementing best practices to enhance data quality and analytical efficiency.
Your NDIA Experience
We work as one team. We are accepting, diverse and driven. We take a shared approach to making progress. We welcome and support each other and encourage different ideas, insights and opinions. We empower and enable each other to be our best. We collaborate, connect and work together to create a workplace that makes us proud. And while we're based far and wide across the country, we make sure nobody feels they are out on their own.

You will work for a socially inclusive and culturally diverse workplace, that is making a meaningful impact to the lives of more than 600,000 Australians.
Access to higher superannuation and above market leave entitlements
Competitive remuneration and working conditions that support a positive work life balance
Access to ongoing professional development and learning

While this role is ideally performed from Deakin - ACT, Surry Hills - NSW, Brisbane - QLD, Adelaide - SA, Geelong & Richmond - VIC & Perth - WA, remote working arrangements may be considered. We intend to fill this role in an ongoing capacity, however non-ongoing roles up to 12 months with the possibility of extension up to 2 years may be offered.
Successful candidates will be required to undergo a pre-employment National Police History check, Worker Screening check and/or Working with Children Check (where required) and provide evidence of Australian Citizenship.
Applications for this role close 11:30pm AEST on 18th May 2025.
If you have any questions, please contact David Owen on 0472 868 674 or email FFTICoperations@ndis.gov.au
With the exception of personal details, applications can NOT be edited or updated once submitted for consideration. Please make sure you are completely satisfied with your entire application before submitting.
NDIA is committed to supporting an inclusive and diverse workforce and welcomes and encourages applications from People with Disability (PwD), First Nations peoples, LGBTIQA+ people, people from Culturally and Linguistically Diverse backgrounds, Mature age workers, as well as young workers and supporting an inter-generational workforce and supporting gender equity and families. If you require an adjustment to be made during the recruitment process (including alternate formats of the application form) or have an enquiry about the support provided, please contact DFP Recruitment on 1300 138 337 ndia@dfp.com.au.
RecruitAbility applies to this position: The RecruitAbility scheme supports people with disability applying for jobs in the Australian Public Service (APS) by giving you a better opportunity to put forward your skills and experience during the selection process.
There are certain roles within the National Disability Insurance that may require mandatory vaccination, subject to government order or directive. Evidence may be required prior to commencement.

Your role
The primary purpose of the role is to optimise business systems, processes, and workflows, ensuring they align with overall business needs and operational objectives.
The Business Analyst (Frontline Divisional Services – Corrective Services) role is to capture business requirements based on consultation/engagement and to review and analyse the organisation's business intentions, services, processes, and information needs to identify changes that lead to business improvements. This is in alignment with business priorities (Line of Business Strategies) and the ICT Strategy.
You will liaise with internal and external clients to identify business needs and articulate requirements, as well as analyse and facilitate improvements to business systems, processes, and workflows.
You will work closely with internal ICT stakeholders such as Project Managers, Architects, Security, Operations, Procurement, Pipeline, and Subject Matter Experts to plan and initiate client-funded projects in response to business needs. You will also be a trusted advisor to the business, providing relevant advice on current ICT solutions as well as future-state initiatives and authoring or providing accurate inputs into key documents such as Concept Papers, Project Briefs, Business Cases, Briefing Notes, and Business Requirements Documents.
What you'll do

By collaborating closely with stakeholders, you'll introduce new or updated tools and processes, clearly demonstrating their importance and the positive impact they bring to the organisation.
 Design tools and implement processes to identify, analyse and facilitate improvements to business systems, processes and workflows aligned with the overall business unit requirements and the Department's operational plans. Develop and implement strategies to monitor service provider usage and capture funding and operational performance data to ensure DCJ service delivery partners are performing to a high standard. Provide proactive and evidence-based advice and reports to the business unit leader, Director and/or the Executive Director to ensure the business unit's matters which impact current business and future decision-making are fully considered. Research and prepare advice in the form of briefs, policy and discussion papers in response to Ministerial, Cabinet or DCJ requests. Liaise and work across DCJ Divisions and non-government stakeholders to ensure effective interface between program development, planning, service design and policy implementation.  Strong attention to detail with the ability to thrive under high-pressure deadlines. {"Our participants, Our people, Our purpose
Currently, there are around 4.3 million Australians with a disability. The National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA) implements the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), which is one of the biggest social reforms in the country since Medicare. As an Agency, we support more than 600,000 participants with a significant and permanent disability, and the families and carers of those living with disability. For many Australians, this will be the first time they receive the disability support they need. The NDIA is designed to enhance the quality of life and increase economic and social participation for people with disability and will mean a peace of mind for every Australian.
A new role awaits
The Fraud Fusion Taskforce and Integrity Capability Division (the Division) has several APS6 Data Analyst opportunities across the Intelligence and Analytics Branch.  The Division drives the Agency’s integrity response and capability uplift as well as the coordination of the whole-of-government multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT).Our Division is responsible for: 

Investigating and responding to internal and external fraud against the NDIS which includes undertaking criminal investigations of serious and organised fraud against the NDIS in partnership with Fraud Fusion Taskforce member agencies.
Managing the tip-off process and collecting?intelligence about integrity concerns to ensure this is acted upon. We develop risk profiles through detection analytics which inform our responses.
Scalable responses, targeted at specific integrity vulnerabilities and cohorts, to address known and emerging integrity and fraud matters.
Fraud investigations, which will progress to prosecutions for serious cases.
Overall governance and management of the multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). This includes development of agreed strategic prevention concepts and priorities across FFT agencies and reporting of savings and benefits.

Enough about us, let’s talk about you
As an APS 6 Data Analyst, you will be accountable under limited direction to undertake complex work that is guided by legislation, policies, procedures, standards, methodologies and precedents.  You will assist in the extraction and production of a range of data, statistics, and reports using Statistical Analysis System (SAS), SQL queries and SAS Visual Analytics (VA).  You will provide expertise and technical knowledge across a range of programs or activities including anticipating problems and contributing to issues management and support the development of detection profiles including requirements, design, testing training and rollout  You will manage relationships with stakeholders to achieve work area goals and communicate and negotiate with clients or stakeholders under limited direction, to maximise acceptance and cooperation and support your team and other initiatives as directed, including the managing, or responding to enquiries including email and Service Desk tickets.  Ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and organizational policies, you will maintain the confidentiality and security of sensitive information. Working closely with management, operational teams, and external partner agencies, you will ensure that intelligence outputs support the strategic and operational needs of the NDIA. Additionally, you will support and contribute to continuous improvement activities, including the development of systems, processes, and practical tools. A strong understanding of machine learning and statistical concepts is highly desirable for this role. Your role will involve identifying opportunities for improving data collection and analysis processes, recommending and implementing best practices to enhance data quality and analytical efficiency.

We work as one team. We are accepting, diverse and driven. We take a shared approach to making progress. We welcome and support each other and encourage different ideas, insights and opinions. We empower and enable each other to be our best. We collaborate, connect and work together to create a workplace that makes us proud. About us
For over 30 years we’ve supported and protected some of the most fragile ecosystems across the continent and seen the impact of our science-based approach. We keep our eyes on the horizon and focus firmly on long-term, landscape scale impact. As a national, not-for-profit, we want to continue to expand the areas we protect and deepen the impact we have. Good understanding of software development practices, and associated programmatic languages such as Python and R.
A good understanding of Conservation Management Process as it relates to the Conservation open standards
Demonstrated knowledge of challenges associated with implementing technology solutions. 
Excellent interpersonal skills and demonstrated success in supporting a diverse range of people enabling the appropriate use of technology aligned to organisational governance arrangements. 
Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities with a strong attention to detail.
Strong knowledge of relevant science & conservation data management processes and demonstrated ability to learn and pick-up new technologies.
Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement in processes and methodologies
Knowledge of delivery frameworks such as AGILE project management, DevOps, ITIL
Commitment to the objectives and values of Bush Heritage.

Great life-work balance: flexible work arrangements with hybrid working.

Employee Resource Groups for women, LGBTQIA+, and neurodivergent employees as well as a social group for bird lovers.


Professional development activities including access to LinkedIn Learning. 


Equitable 12 weeks paid leave to all parents, irrespective of their role as primary or secondary carers. 


Remote staff are supported through an education allowance for kids and additional annual leave.


Access to support and counselling via our Employee Assistance Program and free access to Headspace app.

Melbourne office in docklands with state-of-the-art facilities and gym.

job_details:
{" 
 
Are you passionate about business analytics, and curious about the many ways they can be used to tackle real world problems and drive value? 
Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) uses data to support many decisions. We are looking for a curious and hard-working individual with a strong analytical background and a dedication for self-improvement.
This role will consist of querying complex SQL-based databases, running thorough analysis (e.g. investigating correlation between variables), and visualising insights in an intuitive manner.  Working closely with other highly skilled analysts across FCTG, partnering with our business teams, as well as colleagues across Data Science, Finance and Product.
As the Senior Business Analyst, you'll be the driver of how data is leveraged in solving business problems within their Project Management and Engineering (PM&E) area.  Use your experience to consult with stakeholders in problem-definition, setting success metrics and shaping the way forward through data insights.  
If you are comfortable in tackling sophisticated analytical problems while operating with minimal mentorship and are seeking a stimulating role within a fast-paced and fun business, we encourage you to apply!
 
Day to Day:
 

Manage stakeholders, prioritising business impact, efficiently adapting to business needs, and managing expectations accordingly
Use deep practical understanding of the data, workflows, methods and tooling to autonomously drive analysis and reporting, adapt their tooling and approach based on business and user needs
Reporting, visualization and taking ownership of workflows and structures to make their solutions scalable, reproducible, and long-term focused
Extract data from multiple data sources and combine them into the required datasets for model building or analytics
Conduct exploratory data profiling techniques, product crosstabs, common summary descriptive statistics
Leverage data to shape your product squad's strategy, providing support and leadership
Play a critical role in attacking opaque, unstructured problems; develop core analytic frameworks that shape the way the company thinks about our business
Own projects that span disparate groups with varying levels of technical fluency from end-to-end
Build a data-driven culture, from working with Product Managers, to partnering with engineers on data models, making sure that all decisions accurately utilise the most powerful data available
Mentor data team members in articulating ideas and viewpoints, managing resources, and driving the resolution of issues
Perform exploratory analyses and in-depth research on large data sets to uncover, size and advocate for opportunities that improve the customer experience and key growth KPIs like customer conversion and retention
Communicate not just findings, but also your recommendations to key stakeholders and leadership. 

 
You'll be perfect for the role if you have:

5+ years of experience in product and customer analytics
3+ years of full-time working experience in quantitative analysis roles
3+ years of solid experience hiring, building, mentoring and leading a team
Experience using relational databases and big data via writing performant queries in SQL against multi-terabyte and billion row datasets in Azure Data Lake, EDW, AWS or Hadoop environments
Experience with modern web analytics tools (Adobe analytics, Google Analytics, Mixpanel etc)
Experience using modern visualisation tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik)
Solid experience hiring, building, mentoring and leading a team
Bachelors or master's in mathematics, data science or analytics, or other numerate, finance, business degree

 
What you will enjoy:

SolarWinds, Prometheus. About FTP: FTP is a Perth-based, home-grown success story.  Our Integrated Management System (IMS) product is a modern geospatial monitoring and visualisation platform used in almost 50 sites around the globe. job_details:
{"Job Ref: WesCEF661374 

Be a part of our division wide digital transformation through providing business process analysis support to the ERP implementation program 


Continue to develop your business acumen within a diverse portfolio of future focused businesses  


Seeking professionals with proven experience in commercial and business optimisation  


Full time, fixed term for 9 months. Based in Murdoch, with travel to other sites  

About WesCEF 
Wesfarmers Chemicals, Energy & Fertilisers (WesCEF) is a division of Wesfarmers that harnesses the potential of essential chemicals, minerals, energy and fertilisers through the ingenuity and commitment of our exceptional people. 
Our businesses operate across domestic, national and international markets and our products and services are essential in driving growth and transformation across vital industries. 
Our award-winning Decarbonisation Journey is a source of pride for our 1500 team members whose focus on sustainable solutions to complex challenges is matched by their unwavering commitment to safety. 
Join us. Together, we can harness potential to create a prosperous future. 
The Opportunity 
We're excited to share a fantastic opportunity for an experienced Business Analyst to join our ERP team during an exciting phase of digital transformation. Reporting directly to the ERP Business Process Manager, you'll become an integral part of our dedicated team supporting the ERP implementation program. Your role will encompass a wide range of activities including system testing, stakeholder engagement and training support.  
As a key contributor, you'll be responsible for updating business processes documentation, modelling system solutions at a business level, and working with the business on opportunities for enhancement to ensure the ERP program aligns with its strategic objectives. You'll directly impact our business by translating requirements into application functionality that optimises outcomes.  
This role offers a unique chance to gain exposure across diverse businesses and play a pivotal role in ERP software implementation and business process modelling.   
To excel in this position, you'll need a solid foundation in business acumen, experience in business support of system implementations, and a passion for engaging with stakeholders.  
This is a fixed term role for 9 months. 
About You 
We are seeking professionals with demonstrable post-graduate work experience with aspirations towards broader roles in business management.  
Experience from a range of backgrounds will be considered including similar roles with the Big 4, commercial organisations, management consulting and commerce. To excel in the role, you will need the right mix of skills and experience, which for this position means:  

Sound business acumen with a willingness to ask questions and challenge assumptions.  


Experience in business process modelling will be highly regarded; 


Attention to detail is essential to support documentation and implementation activities; 


Well-developed verbal and written communication skills with the ability to actively participate in focus group, workshops and client interviews.  

Who are our businesses?  
Our team support a range of leaders and teams across WesCEF including those in the Shared Services functions based in Murdoch, and also a diverse group of mature and stable businesses including CSBP Ammonia Ammonium Nitrate, Australian Gold Reagents (AGR), CSBP Fertilisers & Kleenheat.   
Why WesCEF 
Right now at WesCEF, we are looking for ambitious individuals eager for the chance to shine and thrive in their career. In return, we offer the recognition and reward you deserve for making a real impact every working day. 
We are committed to building a talented, engaged and diverse team who reflect the communities we work within. Our work environment embraces a mix of thinking, skills and experiences, which in turn helps us deliver innovation and improved business results.  
We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. 
We’re proud of how we develop and support our team, including offering flexible working hours. When you apply, please let us know if you are seeking flexibility.  
WesCEF operates across multiple locations, with our two major hubs being in Kwinana and Murdoch. This role will be largely based at Murdoch. Our Murdoch office will be relocating to Perth CBD in late 2025.

{"ASC is Australia’s submarine company. We built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives. Our work is interesting and meaningful, contributing directly to Australia’s national security. We offer rewarding roles that provide the opportunity to grow your career, and the flexibility to balance life and work. A career at ASC is like no other, delivering a deeper purpose we can all be proud of.

This role represents a rare opportunity to work on the pioneering SSN AUKUS Build Program, delivering an essential sovereign capability for Australia. Reporting to the Digital Tools – Governance & Support Technologies Manager, based in Osborne SA, your skills and knowledge in engineering processes, engineering software, software development and IT systems will enable you to support and deliver agreed digital tool solutions and outcomes to the business capabilities (‘ASC end users’).  Additionally, your project management experience and knowledge of business and compliance systems will enable you to lead and participate in digital tool governance activities across the organisation.  This full-time, permanent role is undertaken in a dynamic and complex environment where customer service and stakeholder engagement are paramount, and your ability to work independently and collaborate with other teams to deliver successful outcomes is essential.

Provide solutions-focused support, development, and configuration for multiple commercial and in-house developed digital tools while managing multiple priorities and leveraging available technologies 
Represent the various business capabilities as subject matter expert to support the sourcing and implementation of digital tools including all necessary infrastructure and services, on request, via the various internal service providers  
Provide guidance, facilitation, and direction to business capabilities with process development and training to ensure optimal outcomes are realised during the development, implementation, and support phases of digital tools  
Provide liaison and facilitation services as required between business capabilities and internal service providers to ensure the alignment of activities and priorities that support strategic objectives and programs of work 
Provide all levels of user support for the digital tool capabilities provided by the team, such as engineering design, modelling, and analysis tools, including databases and infrastructure 
Undertake effective customer and stakeholder engagement for all tasks with the aim to enhance business outcomes and build relationships
Support digital tool licensing systems 
Collaborate with the corporate IT team to achieve assigned objectives 
Continuously improve digital tool support processes and procedures

Please note: Availability for collaboration calls outside normal working hours (UK timezone) is required. Periodic domestic and international travel may also be required on an ad hoc basis.  
About you  

Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or an equivalent qualification 
Experience using, supporting, and configuring 2D and 3D Computer Aided Design (CAD) methods and tools, such as AVEVA, Autodesk, PTC, or similar 
Experience using, supporting, and configuring multiple engineering, analysis / simulation methods and tools, such as FEA, CFD, MBSE, RAM, Acoustics/Signal analysis, or similar  
Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), PDM (Product Data Management), and/or Document Management methods and tools, such as Dassault Systemes, Autodesk, PTC or similar

Experience working with large datasets and enterprise reporting environments.

{"About us  
HammondCare is a not-for-profit, values-based organisation that is passionate about improving the quality of care for people in need. As one of Australia’s most innovative health and aged care providers, we aim to set the global standard of relationship-based care for people with complex needs. HammondCare provides care primarily through hospitals, residential care homes and home-based care as well as services for dementia support, community palliative care, rehabilitation, positive aging and older persons’ mental health.  
About the role  
HammondCare is currently implementing the Workday HCM suite of products to replace all existing HR systems, with iChris payroll remaining as HammondCare’s payroll processing system. Workday will become the single source of truth for employee data and will integrate with iChris, Salesforce and data warehouse.
The program requires a Data and Reporting Analyst to complete data related tasks for the Workday Program, who will work with stakeholders across HammondCare - including data consumers, data producers, architecture teams and technology to interpret data requirements, their use and applicability to the Workday HCM platform, from the documentation of these right through to implementation, as well as validating data quality after conversion from legacy systems.
In addition, you will be responsible for documenting Data Requirements, Stakeholder Engagement, Data Quality and Data Lineage.  You will also be responsible for understanding and documenting the reporting requirements for the Workday platform and PowerBI. 
What we can offer you
We care about your wellbeing at HammondCare and as a result offer a wide range of health and lifestyle benefits including: 

NFP salary packaging ($15,900 tax free) plus meals and entertainment benefit (up to $2,650 tax free)
Additional leave purchase options and 14 weeks paid parental leave
Flexible working options, including hybrid arrangements
Discounts on everyday products and services
Discounted healthcare memberships - access to network of fitness centres and pools for employees and families
Free access to independent counselling support for employees and families
Health & Wellbeing programmes
Reward & Recognition programmes
Referral bonuses
Career and professional development opportunities

Key Focus Areas

Work with program functional leads and business Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to understand and document HammondCare’s business data requirements and the relevant data sources as applicable to all People processes (including Payroll, strategic and operational reporting).
Ensuring that data requirements align with People  reporting requirements.
Data migration and conversion from legacy systems to Workday.
Data validation and reconciliation with legacy systems.
Data Analysis & Reporting – Transform people data into meaningful insights to support strategic decision-making and people operations using Workday reporting tools (Report Writer, Worksheets, Discovery Boards, dashboards).
Analyse HR and payroll data to identify trends, patterns and insights and communicate these findings to stakeholders in digestible ways
Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to workday reporting
Provide training and support to stakeholders as required and act as a point of contact for internal customers regarding workday reporting
Support data integrity initatives through rigourous resting of new and modified reports to ensure data accuracy and integrity
Data ownership across the People team, ensuring that data definitions and requirements are documented and maintained post-go-live.

 About You  

Commitment to engage and align with HammondCare’s Christian Mission, Motivation and Mission in Action.
4+ years ‘experience as a business analyst, producing data requirements in a business context
Expert knowledge of Excel for data validation and reconciliation
Experience in data definition, data lineage and analysis of data quality measurement aspects
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work both collaboratively and independently
Prior data migration/conversion experience in Workday HCM projects (core HCM, Absence, Compensation Advanced Compensation, Payroll Integration/iChris/Chris21, Talent and Performance, Learning and/or Recruitment) is advantageous
Expertise in data visualisation and storytelling
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
1-2 End to End Workday HCM projects as a data, reporting or business analyst
Experience with Workday’s reporting tools to develop reports (Report Writer, Discovery Boards, dashboards, worksheets etc)

To Apply 
If you are ready to make a difference with HammondCare, Apply Now!    
All short-listed applicants will be asked to consent to a criminal record check and references. 
HammondCare is committed to creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity and inclusion. We strive on creating an equal employment environment where everyone from any background can be themselves."}

job_details: {"If you live in Australia or New Zealand, you've likely heard of AMP. But at a time when society is changing, we are too. We're now a nimbler business with new leadership and thinking.   For us, these are exciting times. There's a real potential for big thinkers to help us redefine what financial services could be. And turn our legacy into something even more positive and powerful for the future.   Help people create their tomorrow, while you create yours   We help people with their banking, super, retirement and finances. Through upturns, downturns, recessions, and major life transitions. Every day, we help people see and make more of their financial potential, so that they can create their tomorrow. And we've been doing it for over 170 years.   If we do our job well, we genuinely add to the prosperity of our country and its people.   How You'll Make an Impact  In this pivotal role, you'll be at the forefront of ensuring our regulatory reporting is meticulously accurate and timely, playing a crucial part in maintaining our compliance standards. Your expertise in capital markets will empower you to navigate complex financial landscapes, driving strategic insights and helping shape our business decisions. By leveraging your technical skills to write SQL queries, you'll dive deep into data analysis, uncovering trends and opportunities that will enhance our operational efficiency and competitive edge. Your contributions will be instrumental in aligning our financial strategies with broader business goals, fostering a culture of transparency and accountability that benefits both our clients and stakeholders.   What You Will Bring to the Role  You bring a wealth of experience in regulatory reporting and a deep understanding of capital markets, essential for steering our financial operations toward success. Your technical proficiency, especially in SQL, allows you to extract, analyse and interpret data with precision, ensuring our reporting is not only accurate but also insightful. Your ability to translate complex data into actionable strategies will be invaluable in driving our business forward. Additionally, your strong analytical skills, coupled with a collaborative approach, will enable you to work seamlessly with cross-functional teams, fostering innovation and continuous improvement in our financial practices.   You'll thrive here if…   If you can adapt from BAU to the ambiguous with ease, you'll do well here. Change is never easy, so bring your commitment, grit and growth mindset.   Because we run lean, you'll be expected to jump in and deliver across a variety of areas. Meaning, you'll be closer to the action and executive decisions that influence where we go next. job_details:
{"HR and Payroll Business Analyst

Join a Global Leader in the Healthcare sector 
Based in Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane with hybrid working and travel to Sydney
12-month FTC leading the renovation of I-MED's people systems

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Business Analyst to contribute to the transformation of our People & Culture and Payroll processes, as we embark on system enhancements and change.  
Job Purpose:
This role will be a vital role in the renovation and integration of our People Systems. Partnering with business stakeholders, this transformation project will involve working with HCM/HRIS, Payroll, WFM and other people systems to design hire to retire processes, across P&C and payroll. During the project, you will identify opportunities for process improvement, design new processes and renovate existing processes and contribute to the transformation of I-MED's P&C and payroll functions.
Key Responsibilities include:

Innovate and Integrate: Lead the transformation of business processes across the P&C and payroll teams ensuring that processes integrate well with the new system solutions.
Drive Efficiency: Identify opportunities to optimise business processes, realise efficiencies, drive compliance and enhance the overall people experience.
Collaborate with Experts: Work closely with People & Culture SMEs, Payroll SMEs, IT Solution Architects, Project Managers and external solution Support Partners / System Integrators to understand and meet business needs. Consult with the business to deliver fit-for-purpose and leading processes
Shape the Future: Document as-is and to-be processes, use cases, and requirements for transformative projects involving HCM/HRIS, WFM, Payroll and other people systems.
Be a Change Maker: Support the development and implementation of system change methodologies, focusing on user-centered design.

About You:

Significant People & Culture / HR and Payroll related business analysis and business process experience
Previous business analysis experience in HCM, WFM & Payroll implementation or renovation projects
Pragmatic approach to requirements gathering/elicitation and process mapping/re-engineering
Exposure to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM, UKG Pro Workforce Management and payroll software is ideal
Experience configuring solutions to meet the needs of multiple awards and enterprise agreements
Experience in developing and executing test cases
Experience in supporting system change methodologies
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to find innovative solutions
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
Adaptability to work in a fast-paced environment, to produce agile solutions

 
About I-MED: Work that matters
I-MED Radiology Network is Australia and New Zealand's largest diagnostic imaging network, offering medical imaging and radiology services including x-ray, PET, CT, MRI, Nuclear Medicine, Ultrasound, Mammography and interventional procedures. 
Across Australia and New Zealand, we operate 240 clinics and perform approximately 7 million patient procedures each year, making us one of the largest providers of medical imaging in the world. With over 450 doctors and 4,000 staff actively sharing clinical knowledge and expertise, a consistently high level of service is assured across all clinics.  Our extensive teleradiology operation supports over 2 million patients annually, providing 24/7 radiology reporting across Australia and New Zealand through I-TeleRAD, and expanding into the US with the 2024 acquisition of StatRad.
At I-MED Radiology Network there is a strong belief that we can be the most respected and trusted medical imaging specialists in the world. That's our vision, underpinned by our purpose - to help save lives and reduce uncertainty. We strive to be the provider of choice, providing answers to health questions and delivering high quality care and service to our patients and referrers, every time.
For more information visit: www.i-med.com.au. 
 
Equal Opportunity Employer: I-MED is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace.

job_details:
{"About us
DHA was established in 1988 following passage of the Defence Housing Australia Act 1987 (DHA Act) to provide adequate and suitable housing for, and housing related services to, members of the Australian Defence Force (ADF) and their families. We remain committed to our purpose of providing housing, and housing related services, to ADF members and their families to support Defence’s operational needs.  
DHA manages an expanding portfolio of housing solutions and provides housing for over 17,200 ADF members and their families and administers rent allowance for more than 16,000 ADF members and their families in private rental accommodation. DHA provides housing related services advising on eligibility, providing posting support, and managing bookings and allocation services for all DHA provisioned housing and on-base accommodation to approximately 60,000 ADF members. 
To find out more about DHA, please refer to our DHA.gov.au or read our latest Annual Report.
About your team
This role reports to the Technology Business Partner within the Business Solutions and Technology (BS&T) business unit. BS&T are responsible for all software related business analysis, business solutions, software development, telephony, IT services, infrastructure and cyber. We deliver business as usual activities and innovation driven initiatives that provide efficiencies to the broader organisation. BS&T supports project management, business contract fulfilment, staff development, productivity increases and enhanced customer service.
About the role
Reporting to the Technology Business Partner, and in line with DHA strategic objectives, the Business Analyst has the following key responsibilities:

Acquire and apply detailed knowledge of DHA’s business capabilities and familiarity with DHA’s Enterprise Applications to commence work quickly and effectively
Facilitate workshops and interviews with a variety of stakeholders to commence elicitation of requirements and validate your understanding of current state processes
Complete and document analysis of current state processes including personas, process mapping, pain point elicitation and identification of potential process reengineering opportunities
Analyse, interpret and compose business rules and requirements into acceptance criteria within user stories
Facilitate collaborative solution design workshops within a multi-disciplinary team so that subject matter experts, developers and testers can contribute to the outcome
Document the agreed design into functional specifications and other technical documents while offering specialist advice to improve implementation and business process improvement. Ensure that the solution addresses the business requirements captured in the acceptance criteria.
Support the creation of basic testing criteria for the documented solution, including investigation and resolution of system problems early in the development process.
Contribute to Enterprise Change Management (ECM) activities by completing showcases and creating content that enables user adoption of system changes.
Actively contribute to the development of the Business Analysis role within DHA by participating in BA meetings and providing insights related to ways of working, templates that are utilised and lessons learned from previous analysis activities.

Benefits for working at DHA include:

15.4% superannuation
Generous leave entitlements, including 18 days personal leave and 20 days annual leave per year
Work-life balance and flexible rostering options
A positive workplace culture where you can bring your whole self to work
Opportunities to broaden your industry knowledge and experience
Career progression and opportunities
ADF partner employment conditions when posting to a new location

For information on DHA’s Employee Value Proposition, visit our website.
How to apply
Apply now via our online careers site with your current resume and a 500-word one page pitch, addressing the requirements of the role. We recommend you read the Australian Public Service Commission’s Cracking the Code guidance on how to write your response. Additionally, you should consider the expected behaviours described in the Australian Public Service Commission’s Integrated Leadership System at this role’s level.
For further information on the position, please refer to the Position Description through the online careers site.
Any questions? Please contact Kirsten Ricetti, Technology Group Business Manager T: 02 6268 3766 E: kirsten.ricetti@dha.gov.au
Order of Merit
A merit pool will be established from this process which will be valid for 18 months from the date of advertising. This merit pool may be used throughout this period to fill similar positions in the event positions become vacant.
Inclusion and Diversity 
DHA is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. We welcome applications from across our community including, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, women, people with disability, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, those who identify as LGBTIQ+, ex-defence members, mature aged employees and carers.

RecruitAbility applies to this vacancy. Under the RecruitAbility scheme you will be invited to participate in further assessment activity for the vacancy if you choose to apply under the scheme; declare you have a disability; and meet the minimum requirements for the job. For more information visit: https://www.apsc.gov.au/recruitability
Eligibility
Employment with DHA is conditional on successful applicants demonstrating that they are an Australian citizen and can obtain and maintain a security clearance at the required level.

About WorkCover Queensland


Our vision is to be the best worker’s compensation insurer, to make a positive difference to people’s lives and to keep Queenslanders working. Our flexible work environment allows you to be your best every day and contribute to the big picture.  


Our organisation is made up of individuals who collaborate and seek to engage others, working together as One Team. We embrace diversity and value people who bring personal energy and authenticity to everything they do. If you’re someone with a strong values-oriented compass and you want to achieve sustainable outcomes, you will find a great community at WorkCover.  


About the Opportunity - Business Analyst 


WorkCover Queensland is embarking on an exciting enterprise transformation journey to modernise our systems, enhance customer experiences, and deliver greater value. This is a unique opportunity to help shape change at scale, right from the start. As an IT Business Analyst in our Digital and Technology team, you’ll join us on a 12-month fixed-term contract, with potential for extension, given the scale of transformation already underway and planned into the future. 


This is a key opportunity to support a range of high-impact initiatives across WorkCover Queensland. The role will focus on early-stage project work — helping shape the future of our enterprise transformation through deep discovery, meaningful stakeholder engagement, and insightful analysis. 


In the early stages of your engagement, your focus will be on actively analysing the current state and identifying opportunities for improvement that will shape the direction and scope of future delivery — including putting forward recommendations for projects that may be stood up as a result. Working closely with stakeholders, you’ll investigate pain points, define business needs, and support system and process improvement opportunities.  


The ideal candidate is proactive, curious, and collaborative — someone who values clarity, evidence-based insight, and building the right foundation for change. 


You will also bring: 




Demonstrated experience in business analysis across the full lifecycle, preferably in insurance/financial services (advantageous), including the ability to elicit, document, and manage both functional and non-functional requirements in fast-paced and ambiguous environments. 


Proven experience working through the discovery phase or early-stage project activities, or compliance/legislative/regulatory projects is advantageous but not essential.  






Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess current-state operations and develop future-state recommendations and models that deliver tangible business benefits, driving optimisation and improvement opportunities. 






Proven ability to facilitate workshops and engage with diverse stakeholders, translating business needs into clear technical outcomes while effectively managing scope, risks, and dependencies. 


Experience in stakeholder engagement, requirements scoping, and process mapping including BPMN, with the ability to contribute to multiple phases of the project lifecycle, from initiation through to delivery. 




A bit about us: 


The Digital and Technology team at WorkCover Queensland are a group of curious problem-solvers, tech enthusiasts, and change-makers who are passionate about using technology and data to enable better business outcomes. We thrive on collaboration, love a good whiteboard session (virtual or otherwise), and enjoy tackling complex challenges that create real value for our customers and people. Whether we’re shaping new solutions or refining everyday processes, we support each other and take pride in driving impactful change across the organisation. 


Working in a collaborative team environment within a supportive and engaged organisation, you’ll enjoy a hybrid work model, access to personalised learning and development opportunities and the holistic support of our health and wellbeing program. We offer industry competitive salaries, a generous superannuation scheme (including co-contribution) and study assistance. You can find out more about our Employee Benefits by visiting Working at WorkCover Qld.   How do I apply? Please submit your resume along with a covering letter that outlines your interest in the role and highlights your relevant experience. We encourage you to reflect on the key elements of the opportunity when preparing your application. Applications close at 9am, Thursday 15 May. 



We are committed to ensuring WorkCover reflects the diversity of the Queensland community. We welcome applications from First Nations peoples, members of the LGBTQIA+SB community, people of all ages, people who are neurodivergent, people with disability, and people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds. 


To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them. 


Pre-employment checks will be conducted on all prospective employees. This will include a Right to Work in Australia Check, Police Check, Education Check, Reference Check and where appropriate a Visa Check. The information provided will be treated as confidential in accordance with the Information Privacy Act 2009 (Qld). 
"}

Experience in integrating PLM systems with other enterprise systems such as ERP, MRP and CAD systems.
Experience in a Defense, Aviation, or complex / large multinational organization.
Current or previous Australian Defense Security clearance

Customer focus with strong interpersonal communication skills.

Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization.
Outcomes focused with strong partnering abilities.

Work on a diverse portfolio with a broad stakeholder group, backed by a supportive Digital Engineering team environment
A competitive package with salary packaging, additional leave entitlements, and annual Employee Incentive Program (bonus) potential
Hybrid working arrangements
Global opportunities in the Boeing Company

{"SAP Business Analyst – Readiness Project
Location: Murarrie, free onsite parking
Contract Type: 12 month Fixed Term Contract

About the Role:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Business Analyst to join a critical SAP Readiness Project that lays the foundation for a future SAP migration. The project is in its initial phase, focusing on identifying current system gaps, manual processes, and workarounds, with the goal of building a business case and project plan for board approval.

This is not a junior BA role—we need someone highly experienced who can confidently lead workshops, engage change-resistant stakeholders, and analyse both SAP and the surrounding ecosystem to prepare the business for future-state planning.

Key Responsibilities:
•    Engage with business stakeholders to uncover current workarounds, inefficiencies, and misuse of SAP functions.
•    Analyse existing processes and data sources, including legacy systems like PeopleSoft.
•    Lead and facilitate workshops and interviews with users who may be resistant to change.
•    Collaborate with internal SMEs, integration owners, solution architects, and technical teams.
•    Document current vs future state requirements and present findings to support strategic planning.
•    Identify risks related to data integrity, system integration, and compliance—especially in critical areas like payroll, finance, and government funding claims.
•    Support the PM in creating clear, evidence-based business cases and risk assessments.
•    Contribute to planning for a migration to either SAP Public Cloud (Greenfield) or Private Cloud (Brownfield), including data migration, security, and governance considerations.
•    Ensure alignment with internal BAU operations and facilitate a smooth transition back post-project.

About You (Must-Have):
•    Proven experience as an SAP Business Analyst—this is non-negotiable.
•    Experience with SAP HXM (preferably Cloud) and a solid understanding of SAP migrations.
•    Strong process mapping and gap analysis skills across finance, payroll, and integrated systems.
•    Confidence in managing stakeholder resistance and driving consensus through influence.
•    Experience working with large, complex data environments and legacy system integrations.
•    Ability to identify and document risks and opportunities across interconnected systems.
•    Excellent communication and facilitation skills—this role requires you to build solid relationships and guide.

Additional Details:
•    Project has executive sponsorship with strong momentum following a consulting phase.
•    Payroll is a critical system—stability and continuity are key concerns.
•    Integration across finance, HR, and custom modules tied to government reimbursements will be in scope.
•    This is a unique opportunity to shape the future-state SAP landscape from the ground up.

Work Environment:
•    Majority of the team is based onsite, and while some flexibility exists, preference is for in-office presence for workshops, whiteboarding, and stakeholder collaboration.
•    No travel required.

job_details:
{"Our participants, Our people, Our purpose
Currently, there are around 4.3 million Australians with a disability. The National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA) implements the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), which is one of the biggest social reforms in the country since Medicare. As an Agency, we support more than 600,000 participants with a significant and permanent disability, and the families and carers of those living with disability. For many Australians, this will be the first time they receive the disability support they need. The NDIA is designed to enhance the quality of life and increase economic and social participation for people with disability and will mean a peace of mind for every Australian.
A new role awaits
The Fraud Fusion Taskforce and Integrity Capability Division (the Division) has several APS6 Business Analyst opportunities across the Intelligence and Analytics Branch. The Division drives the Agency’s integrity response and capability uplift as well as the coordination of the whole-of-government multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). Our Division is responsible for: •    Investigating and responding to internal and external fraud against the NDIS which includes undertaking criminal investigations of serious and organised fraud against the NDIS in partnership with Fraud Fusion Taskforce member agencies.•    Managing the tip-off process and collecting intelligence about integrity concerns to ensure this is acted upon. We develop risk profiles through detection analytics which inform our responses.•    Scalable responses, targeted at specific integrity vulnerabilities and cohorts, to address known and emerging integrity and fraud matters. •    Fraud investigations, which will progress to prosecutions for serious cases.•    Overall governance and management of the multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). This includes development of agreed strategic prevention concepts and priorities across FFT agencies and reporting of savings and benefits.
Where you can add value
The APS6 Business Analyst will develop business functional requirements and resources, consistent with contractual, legislative, and policy environments. You will translate business metrics to inform internal stakeholder requirements, including efficiency, improvement, and performance outcomes to optimize customer experience.  In this role you will produce reports, interpret data, and analyse results using standard statistical techniques while also coordinating divisional and branch reporting requirements to monitor and track improvement and performance outcomes. You will design and deliver workshops, communication, and consultation resources that support complex systems and business information gathering and sharing. Additionally, you will implement and maintain audit and risk processes, controls, and undertake issues resolution.
Your NDIA Experience
We work as one team. We are accepting, diverse and driven. We take a shared approach to making progress. We welcome and support each other and encourage different ideas, insights and opinions. We empower and enable each other to be our best. We collaborate, connect and work together to create a workplace that makes us proud. And while we're based far and wide across the country, we make sure nobody feels they are out on their own.

You will work for a socially inclusive and culturally diverse workplace, that is making a meaningful impact to the lives of more than 600,000 Australians.
Access to higher superannuation and above market leave entitlements
Competitive remuneration and working conditions that support a positive work life balance
Access to ongoing professional development and learning

While this role is ideally performed from Canberra, ACT; Sydney, NSW; Melbourne, VIC; Brisbane,QLD or Perth, WA, remote working arrangements may be considered. job_details:
{"Our participants, Our people, Our purpose
Currently, there are around 4.3 million Australians with a disability. The National Disability Insurance Agency (NDIA) implements the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS), which is one of the biggest social reforms in the country since Medicare. As an Agency, we support more than 600,000 participants with a significant and permanent disability, and the families and carers of those living with disability. For many Australians, this will be the first time they receive the disability support they need. The NDIA is designed to enhance the quality of life and increase economic and social participation for people with disability and will mean a peace of mind for every Australian.
A new role awaits
The Fraud Fusion Taskforce and Integrity Capability Division (the Division) has several APS6 Business Analyst opportunities across the Intelligence and Analytics Branch. The Division drives the Agency’s integrity response and capability uplift as well as the coordination of the whole-of-government multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). Our Division is responsible for: •    Investigating and responding to internal and external fraud against the NDIS which includes undertaking criminal investigations of serious and organised fraud against the NDIS in partnership with Fraud Fusion Taskforce member agencies.•    Managing the tip-off process and collecting intelligence about integrity concerns to ensure this is acted upon. We develop risk profiles through detection analytics which inform our responses.•    Scalable responses, targeted at specific integrity vulnerabilities and cohorts, to address known and emerging integrity and fraud matters. •    Fraud investigations, which will progress to prosecutions for serious cases.•    Overall governance and management of the multi-agency Fraud Fusion Taskforce (FFT). This includes development of agreed strategic prevention concepts and priorities across FFT agencies and reporting of savings and benefits.
Where you can add value
The APS6 Business Analyst will develop business functional requirements and resources, consistent with contractual, legislative, and policy environments. You will translate business metrics to inform internal stakeholder requirements, including efficiency, improvement, and performance outcomes to optimize customer experience.  In this role you will produce reports, interpret data, and analyse results using standard statistical techniques while also coordinating divisional and branch reporting requirements to monitor and track improvement and performance outcomes. You will design and deliver workshops, communication, and consultation resources that support complex systems and business information gathering and sharing. Additionally, you will implement and maintain audit and risk processes, controls, and undertake issues resolution.
Your NDIA Experience
We work as one team. We are accepting, diverse and driven. We take a shared approach to making progress. We welcome and support each other and encourage different ideas, insights and opinions. We empower and enable each other to be our best. We collaborate, connect and work together to create a workplace that makes us proud. And while we're based far and wide across the country, we make sure nobody feels they are out on their own.

You will work for a socially inclusive and culturally diverse workplace, that is making a meaningful impact to the lives of more than 600,000 Australians.
Access to higher superannuation and above market leave entitlements
Competitive remuneration and working conditions that support a positive work life balance
Access to ongoing professional development and learning

job_details:
{"Seeking a unique skill set to support Digital Tools and the broader Transfer of Technology objectives. Requires multi-discipline experience with engineering, IT & project management

Attractive salary & industry-leading benefits
Shape Australia's defence capabilities through innovative design
Flexible work arrangements and up to 10 additional days of leave annually

 
ASC is Australia’s submarine company. We built the Royal Australian Navy’s Collins Class submarines, sustain them, and are now delivering their Life of Type Extension to increase the boats’ service lives. We have also been selected by the Australian Government to sustain and jointly build the nation’s nuclear-powered submarines – the largest and most complex industrial undertaking in Australia’s history.
Our work is interesting and meaningful, contributing directly to Australia’s national security. We offer rewarding roles that provide the opportunity to grow your career, and the flexibility to balance life and work. A career at ASC is like no other, delivering a deeper purpose we can all be proud of.
About the Opportunity  
Reporting to the Digital Tools – Governance & Support Technologies Manager, based in Osborne SA, your skills and knowledge in engineering processes, engineering software, software development and IT systems will enable you to support and deliver agreed digital tool solutions and outcomes to the business capabilities (‘ASC end users’).  Additionally, your project management experience and knowledge of business and compliance systems will enable you to lead and participate in digital tool governance activities across the organisation.  This full-time, permanent role is undertaken in a dynamic and complex environment where customer service and stakeholder engagement are paramount, and your ability to work independently and collaborate with other teams to deliver successful outcomes is essential. 
Responsibilities

Provide solutions-focused support, development, and configuration for multiple commercial and in-house developed digital tools while managing multiple priorities and leveraging available technologies 
Represent the various business capabilities as subject matter expert to support the sourcing and implementation of digital tools including all necessary infrastructure and services, on request, via the various internal service providers 
Provide guidance, facilitation, and direction to business capabilities with process development and training to ensure optimal outcomes are realised during the development, implementation, and support phases of digital tools 
Provide liaison and facilitation services as required between business capabilities and internal service providers to ensure the alignment of activities and priorities that support strategic objectives and programs of work 
Provide all levels of user support for the digital tool capabilities provided by the team, such as engineering design, modelling, and analysis tools, including databases and infrastructure 
Undertake effective customer and stakeholder engagement for all tasks with the aim to enhance business outcomes and build relationships
Support digital tool licensing systems 
Collaborate with the corporate IT team to achieve assigned objectives 
Continuously improve digital tool support processes and procedures 
Contribute to team building, mentoring, and informal training activities within the team 
Engage and communicate effectively with a wide variety of team members throughout the organisation 
Maintain professional relationships with and coordinate support from external application/service providers 

About you

Degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science or an equivalent qualification 
Experience using, supporting, and configuring 2D and 3D Computer Aided Design (CAD) methods and tools, such as AVEVA, Autodesk, PTC, or similar 
Experience using, supporting, and configuring multiple engineering, analysis / simulation methods and tools, such as FEA, CFD, MBSE, RAM, Acoustics/Signal analysis, or similar
Familiarity with PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), PDM (Product Data Management), and/or Document Management methods and tools, such as Dassault Systemes, Autodesk, PTC or similar 
Familiarity with ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) methods and tools, such as IFS, SAP, Microsoft 
Familiarity with enterprise technologies and processes including infrastructure hardware and applications is desirable
Experience with SQL database methods and tools such as Microsoft, Oracle, or similar 
Experience with scripting / programming languages such as PowerShell, C#, .NET, VBA  
Excellent problem solving and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities 
Understanding of Defence systems engineering standards and regulations (preferably Defence Seaworthiness) will be highly regarded 

You’re an ideal candidate for this role if you are one of the following:

An engineer with demonstrated experience in effectively utilising and customising engineering design, modelling and analysis software applications, demonstrated project management experience, IT infrastructure knowledge, and someone who can develop production-level code/scripts and understands data structures 
A software developer, applications/infrastructure engineer, IT systems/support engineer or database engineer with demonstrated project management experience who is interested in undertaking development, support, and project leadership tasks for engineering design, modelling and analysis software applications and defence/manufacturing enterprise-level software
A business analyst with strong software development, engineering skills, and IT infrastructure knowledge who is interested in undertaking development, support and project leadership tasks for engineering design, modelling and analysis software applications and defence/manufacturing enterprise-level software 

Eligibility
This role requires a current National Police Clearance, an Australian Defence Security Clearance and an ability to access protected US defence technology. Your eligibility for this role is dependent on you obtaining and maintaining such clearances and approvals.
Whilst ASC will accept all applications for this role, as this role requires an ability to access protected US defence technology, applicants holding nationality of certain foreign countries will not be eligible.
To check your eligibility please visit the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency website.
Benefits

Unique and challenging work with a deeper purpose.
Flexibility over how, when and where you work for the best work/life balance.
Up to 10 days additional leave every year so you can rest and recharge.
Generous parental leave so you can give your family the focus it deserves.
Subsidised childcare to ease the financial pressure on your family.
Health and wellbeing initiatives so you can perform at your best at work.
Professional development opportunities to advance your career.
A diverse and supportive environment where you can thrive.
Discounts and exclusive offers from leading Australian brands to help you save.

About ASC
Established in 1985, ASC’s 1900-plus staff offer a depth of submarine design, project management, supply chain, construction and engineering experience and expertise that is unparalleled in Australia’s defence industry. The company’s work on Australia’s nuclear-powered submarine build and the Collins Class Life of Type Extension takes place in Osborne, South Australia, with sustainment shared across Osborne and Henderson, Western Australia. ASC also plays a leading role in training Royal Australian Navy submariners.
Apply today for a career with a deeper purpose.
Early applications are encouraged as shortlisting may commence immediately."}
